item.title: Attachable 1.0.2
item.description:
### Attachable 1.0.2
- Turn on Attachable's right-click actions in one click: you're offered it the first time, and anytime from Settings. - Location is now removed from every photo and video when that setting is on, even ones that were already small. - Steadier with very long PDFs, scans inside ZIPs and network drives.
